kind: Predeclared single-factor fused-baseline development trial (development only; not an optimizer comparison)
factor: actor lr 5e-6 -> 1e-6 (rl.optimizer.lr), on the trial-1 native LIBERO-10 profile
unchanged: native profile (8 envs on 8 GPUs, 16-decision windows, global_minibatch 32, 4 updates per window), value_lr 1e-4, betas/eps/decay/clip 1.0, fused AdamW fp32_master, checkpoint, aligned_200, seed 17, BF16 compute, frozen backbone
success_criterion: PASS iff every completed aligned_200 evaluation at update >= 80 has success >= 0.885 (>= 177/200) AND mean episode_steps <= 339.10. Any completed evaluation at update >= 80 violating either bound FAILS the trial and the job is cancelled. The update-80 evaluation must complete or the trial is censored.
falsification: The hypothesis 'effective (FP32-master) updates at the native actor lr 5e-6 are too large for this policy; 1e-6 keeps the policy stable' is falsified if this trial fails.
next_if_fail: One remaining trial (3): value-warmup period, predeclared before submission.
